title: Transcript modality absent from agentic graph: no path ever runs the tantivy edge projection
wanted_capability: Transcript chunk vertices and IN_SESSION edges present in the agentic graph so transcript_provenance queries, bbox_blame transcript hops, and eval required_evidence=IN_SESSION can resolve. Since commit ffd9027e made the tantivy stored-doc projection opt-in, every remaining caller of rebuild_edge_index_from_shared passes include_tantivy_projection=false (the last true caller, rebuild_edge_index_from_stores, was flipped in the spawn_blocking sweep; boot rebuild hardcodes false in src/server/open.rs). Result: describe_schema reports transcript: 0 entities, sessions carry zero IN_SESSION edges, and the whole transcript_provenance eval class is structurally zeroed. The hybrid BM25 lane still surfaces transcript docs (hybrid_entity_id synthesizes transcript: refs), so the hole is specifically the edge/vertex layer.
missing_primitive: Query-time IN_SESSION synthesis for transcript refs (forward direction is purely derivable from the ref; no materialization needed), plus a tantivy-backed transcript count for describe_schema
fallback_used: None; discovered while root-causing the six permanently-zero transcript eval manifests (4 of 5 referenced sessions additionally purged from the corpus)
